data.long_meaning: The name Lob is derived from the Sanskrit word 'lobha' which means 'wave' or 'surge'. The name evokes images of the mighty waves crashing against the shores, bringing immense energy and life-giving power. In Hindu rituals and traditions, the ocean is often considered a symbol of purification and renewal. The name Lob thus carries the essence of strength, power, and the endless cycle of life.
